steps.text: Go north from Venore through the Green Claw Swamp to the Amazon camp (amazons). Witch Hill is in the middle of the camp: go up.
steps.source: Travel through Green Claw Swamp to the Amazon Encampment, North of Venore. "Witch Hill" is located near the center of the camp.

steps.text: On the hill: two witches, valkyries and a lion.
steps.source: After defeating two Witches, three Valkeries and two Lions, open the two boxes to obtain 2 bags

steps.text: The left box: a bag with the skull of Ratha and a white pearl.
steps.source: open the two boxes to obtain 2 bags: one containing a White Pearl, the Skull of Ratha

steps.text: The right box: a bag with a wolf tooth chain and a dwarven ring.
steps.source: and a second containing a Wolf Tooth Chain and a Dwarven Ring.

steps.text: Go back down the hill and down the trapdoor of the witch house.
steps.source: To get there go downstairs the "Witch house" (purple mark).

steps.text: Follow the basement east: a witch and valkyries guard the chest.
steps.source: Follow the map of this basement in order to obtain your reward, it is guarded by a Witch and 3-5 Valkeries.

steps.text: The chest: a bag with 100 gold, a crystal necklace and 2 black pearls.
steps.source: Once they are defeated, open the chest to find a bag with 100gp, a Crystal Necklace, and 2 Black Pearls.
